- **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers**: dark brown/black necrotic canker near soil — clearly doesn't match.
- **Bacterial_Speck**: small dark circular spots on leaves — doesn't match.
- **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch**: circular spots with dark halos — doesn't match.

The white powdery coating on the stem is the hallmark of Powdery Mildew, which can infect stems as well as leaves in tomato.
